lesson: [2026-09-28 retrospective interpretation; no new experiment] The frozen gain-normalised ridge recipe missed G8.2-r2 on the historical song split: its best two-second channel R2 was +0.0045 versus the zero null and the required +0.20. The loudest-third versus quietest-third section QoM ratio of 1.57, CI [1.52, 1.63], versus equality at 1 supports that measured movement contrast, not the registered chorus/verse endpoint or LIGHT quality. Genre/Effort partialling and independently labelled chorus/verse response remain unmeasured, and inter-coach agreement does not establish audio learnability or a corpus-wide capability ceiling.
